title: [ticker-reference-dated] tickerIndexDatedEnabled: characterization test for case, false and the FULL flag alone
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for tickerIndexDatedEnabled in src/ticker-reference-dated.ts: dated flag
- tickerIndexDatedEnabled({ TICKER_INDEX_DATED: "true", TICKER_INDEX_DATED_FULL: "false" }) is true
- tickerIndexDatedEnabled({ TICKER_INDEX_DATED: "TRUE" }) is false
- tickerIndexDatedEnabled({ TICKER_INDEX_DATED: "false" }) is false
- tickerIndexDatedEnabled({ TICKER_INDEX_DATED_FULL: "true" }) is false

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v6): Peace's task (source: peace). tickerIndexDatedEnabled is tested with {}, "1" and "true"; "TRUE", "false", TICKER_INDEX_DATED_FULL alone (does not enable) and true with FULL false are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 0ab37c8 (Workspace main 1e8448a, live 30-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v6); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with tickerIndexDatedEnabled stubbed); suite 613/613 with all fifteen new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
